observables: tools/list preserves the nine certified tools and appends exactly bateia_start_improvement_synthesis
new recommendation runs extract a safe deterministic mechanism_catalog only from their frozen EvidenceBundle
historical recommendation runs without mechanism_catalog remain SOURCE_BASIS_UNAVAILABLE and never reread mutable sources
PROVEN mechanisms require implementation and an independent witness in the same immutable owner/repo@commit
product-only observations never become architectural mechanisms and external proposals never create evidence
target UNKNOWN never becomes ABSENT and lifecycle SUCCEEDED never becomes hypothesis SUPPORTED
source artifact run kind, terminal lifecycle, artifact allowlist and client hash are verified before queueing
improvement synthesis reuses the Step 0026 store, queue, idempotency, cancellation, quota and cursor semantics
unknown license blocks automatic component reuse without dropping the mechanism or hypothesis
popularity, AdoptionRate and novelty never increase evidence or support status
counterevidence, integration unknowns, assumptions, risks and falsifiable validation plans remain explicit
offline replay is network-free and byte-identical and public artifacts contain no raw third-party content or canaries
L1 remains pure, L2 has no L3 dependency, L3 has no upward dependency and L4 only composes
certificates 0025, 0026 and 0027 receive explicit observable-refinement receipts
unknown_policy: Missing historical catalogs remain SOURCE_BASIS_UNAVAILABLE; unsupported taxonomy, incomplete witnesses, unknown target state, absent property baselines, unknown cross-mechanism compatibility, unknown license and budget-limited counterevidence remain explicit. Unknown never becomes absence, proof, compatibility, safety or reuse permission. Opaque cases are excluded from mutation-score success and may only yield Unknown when designated before the candidate.
